results.title: The x-form of a covering
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a field and $d,a,b\in K$ with $a,b\ne0$. Then the 2-covering $D_{a,b}$ of $C_d$ is soluble over $K$ if and only if its x-form holds: $a$ and $b$ are squares, or some $x\in K$ makes $x/a$, $(x-d)/b$ and $(x+d)/(ab)$ squares.

results.title: Squares in the p-adic numbers
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $x\in\mathbb Q_p$ nonzero, $x=p^ku$ with $u$ a unit of $\mathbb Z_p$.

results.title: Local solubility at the real place
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $d>0$ and $a,b\ne0$ be real numbers. Then the covering $D_{a,b}$ of $C_d$ is soluble over $\mathbb R$ (in its x-form) if and only if $a$ and $b$ have the same sign. In particular this holds for integers $d>0$ and $a,b\ne0$.

results.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and $d,a,b$ nonzero elements of $\mathbb F_p$. Then either $a$ and $b$ are squares in $\mathbb F_p$, or there is $\xi\in\mathbb F_p$ such that $\xi/a$, $(\xi-d)/b$ and $(\xi+d)/(ab)$ are squares (zero allowed).

results.title: Local solubility at odd primes not dividing d
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, $d$ a natural number with $p\nmid d$, and $a,b$ integers.

results.title: Local solubility at odd primes dividing d
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, $d$ a squarefree natural number divisible by $p$, and $a,b$ nonzero integers. Then $D_{a,b}$ is soluble over $\mathbb Q_p$ (in its x-form) if and only if there are $i,j\in\{0,1\}$ such that $ad^i(-1)^j$ and $b\,2^i(-d)^j$ are squares in $\mathbb Q_p$; that is, $(a,b)$ is one of the four torsion classes $(1,1)$, $(d,2)$, $(-1,-d)$, $(-d,-2d)$.

results.title: Local solubility at the place 2
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $d$ be an odd natural number (in particular $d\equiv5\pmod8$) and $a,b$ nonzero integers. Then $D_{a,b}$ is soluble over $\mathbb Q_2$ (in its x-form) if and only if there are $i,j,k\in\{0,1\}$ such that $ad^i(-1)^j$ and $b\,2^i(-d)^j5^k$ are squares in $\mathbb Q_2$: the four torsion classes and their products with $(1,5)$.

results.title: The 2-Selmer group of a congruent number curve
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a natural number $d$, the *2-Selmer group* $\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ is the set of pairs $(a,b)$ of squarefree integers (signs allowed) such that the 2-covering $D_{a,b}$ of $C_d:y^2=x^3-d^2x$ is soluble (in its x-form) over $\mathbb R$ and over $\mathbb Q_p$ for every prime $p$, $p=2$ included.

results.title: The certified rank hypothesis in Selmer form
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The hypothesis CR₃^Sel is the following assertion. Let $d$ be a squarefree positive integer with $d\equiv5\pmod8$. Suppose that the 2-Selmer group $\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ has exactly $8$ elements and contains a pair $(a,b)$ with $|a|\equiv7\pmod8$. Then for every $(a',b')\in\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ the 2-covering $D_{a',b'}$ is soluble over $\mathbb Q$ (in its x-form).

results.title: The certified rank hypothesis from its Selmer form
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The hypothesis CR₃^Sel implies the certified rank hypothesis CR₃.
